mapper.insert: insert into `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_user` (tenant_id, member_id, user_name, nick_name, phone, email, password, status, must_change_password, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, is_delete) values (#{tenantId}, #{merchantId}, #{user.userName}, #{user.nickName}, #{user.phone}, #{user.email}, #{password}, 0, 1, #{operator}, sysdate(), #{operator}, sysdate(), '商户端新增用户', 0)

insert into `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_user_member` (tenant_id, member_id, merchant_user_id, member_role, warehouse_scope_type, sensitive_scope, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, is_delete) values (#{tenantId}, #{merchantId}, #{userId}, #{memberRole}, #{warehouseScopeType}, 2, 0, #{operator}, sysdate(), #{operator}, sysdate(), '商户端用户仓库权限', 0) on duplicate key update member_role = values(member_role), warehouse_scope_type = values(warehouse_scope_type), status = 0, update_by = values(update_by), update_time = sysdate(), is_delete = 0

(#{tenantId}, #{merchantId}, #{userId}, #{warehouseId}, #{operator}, sysdate(), 0)
on duplicate key update is_delete = 0, create_by = values(create_by), create_time = values(create_time)
mapper.select: select u.merchant_user_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.phone, u.email, u.status, u.must_change_password, u.login_date, u.create_time, um.member_role, case when um.member_role = 'owner' or exists (select 1 from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_user_role` admin_ur inner join `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_role` admin_r on admin_r.tenant_id = admin_ur.tenant_id and admin_r.member_id = admin_ur.member_id and admin_r.role_id = admin_ur.role_id where admin_ur.tenant_id = u.tenant_id and admin_ur.member_id = u.member_id and admin_ur.merchant_user_id = u.merchant_user_id and admin_ur.is_delete = 0 and admin_r.role_key = 'merchant_admin' and admin_r.status = 0 and admin_r.is_delete = 0) then 1 else um.warehouse_scope_type end warehouse_scope_type, group_concat(distinct r.role_name order by r.role_id separator ',') role_names from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_user` u inner join `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_user_member` um on um.tenant_id = u.tenant_id and um.member_id = u.member_id and um.merchant_user_id = u.merchant_user_id and um.is_delete = 0 and um.status = 0 left join `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_user_role` ur on ur.tenant_id = u.tenant_id and ur.member_id = u.member_id and ur.merchant_user_id = u.merchant_user_id and ur.is_delete = 0 left join `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_role` r on r.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id and r.member_id = ur.member_id and r.role_id = ur.role_id and r.is_delete = 0 where u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and u.member_id = #{merchantId} and u.is_delete = 0 and u.user_name like concat('%', #{query.userName}, '%') and u.phone like concat('%', #{query.phone}, '%') and u.status = #{query.status} group by u.merchant_user_id order by u.create_time desc, u.merchant_user_id desc

select u.merchant_user_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.phone, u.email, u.status, u.must_change_password, u.login_date, u.create_time, um.member_role, case when um.member_role = 'owner' or exists (select 1 from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_user_role` admin_ur inner join `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_role` admin_r on admin_r.tenant_id = admin_ur.tenant_id and admin_r.member_id = admin_ur.member_id and admin_r.role_id = admin_ur.role_id where admin_ur.tenant_id = u.tenant_id and admin_ur.member_id = u.member_id and admin_ur.merchant_user_id = u.merchant_user_id and admin_ur.is_delete = 0 and admin_r.role_key = 'merchant_admin' and admin_r.status = 0 and admin_r.is_delete = 0) then 1 else um.warehouse_scope_type end warehouse_scope_type, group_concat(distinct r.role_name order by r.role_id separator ',') role_names from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_user` u inner join `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_user_member` um on um.tenant_id=u.tenant_id and um.member_id=u.member_id and um.merchant_user_id=u.merchant_user_id and um.is_delete=0 left join `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_user_role` ur on ur.tenant_id=u.tenant_id and ur.member_id=u.member_id and ur.merchant_user_id=u.merchant_user_id and ur.is_delete=0 left join `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_role` r on r.tenant_id=ur.tenant_id and r.member_id=ur.member_id and r.role_id=ur.role_id and r.is_delete=0 where u.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and u.member_id=#{merchantId} and u.merchant_user_id=#{userId} and u.is_delete=0 group by u.merchant_user_id
mapper.update: update `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_user` set nick_name=#{nickname}, phone=#{phone}, email=#{email}, status=#{status}, update_by=#{operator}, update_time=sysdate() where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and member_id=#{merchantId} and merchant_user_id=#{userId} and is_delete=0

select distinct r.role_key from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_role` r inner join `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_user_role` ur on ur.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and ur.member_id = r.member_id and ur.role_id = r.role_id where r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and r.member_id = #{merchantId} and ur.merchant_user_id = #{userId} and r.status = 0 and r.is_delete = 0 and ur.is_delete = 0

select distinct m.perms from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_menu` m where m.tenant_id = 0 and m.member_id = 0 and m.status = 0 and m.is_delete = 0 and m.perms is not null and m.perms != '' and ( exists (select 1 from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_user_menu` um where um.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and um.member_id = #{merchantId} and um.merchant_user_id = #{userId} and um.menu_id = m.menu_id and um.is_delete = 0) or exists (select 1 from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_user_role` ur inner join `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_role` r on r.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id and r.member_id = ur.member_id and r.role_id = ur.role_id inner join `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_role_menu` rm on rm.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id and rm.member_id = ur.member_id and rm.role_id = ur.role_id where ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and ur.member_id = #{merchantId} and ur.merchant_user_id = #{userId} and rm.menu_id = m.menu_id and ur.is_delete = 0 and rm.is_delete = 0 and r.status = 0 and r.is_delete = 0) or exists (select 1 from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_user_role` ur inner join `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_role` r on r.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id and r.member_id = ur.member_id and r.role_id = ur.role_id where ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and ur.member_id = #{merchantId} and ur.merchant_user_id = #{userId} and ur.is_delete = 0 and r.role_key = 'merchant_admin' and r.status = 0 and r.is_delete = 0) )

select distinct perms from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_menu` where tenant_id = 0 and member_id = 0 and status = 0 and is_delete = 0 and perms is not null and perms != '' and (perms like 'merchant:%:list' or perms like 'merchant:%:query') order by perms

mapper.insert: insert into `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_user` (tenant_id, member_id, user_name, nick_name, phone, email, password, status, is_delete, must_change_password, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{account.tenantId}, #{account.merchantId}, #{account.username}, #{account.nickname}, #{account.phone}, #{account.email}, null, 0, 0, 1, #{operator}, sysdate(), '商户注册后自动开通的管理员账号，审核通过后开放业务功能，首次登录需设置密码')

mapper.insert: insert into `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_user_member` (tenant_id, member_id, merchant_user_id, member_role, warehouse_scope_type, sensitive_scope, status, create_by, create_time, is_delete) values (#{tenantId}, #{merchantId}, #{userId}, 'owner', 1, 2, 0, #{operator}, sysdate(), 0) on duplicate key update member_role = 'owner', status = 0, is_delete = 0, update_by = values(create_by), update_time = sysdate()

insert into `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_role` (tenant_id, member_id, role_template_id, role_name, role_key, role_sort, menu_check_strictly, status, is_delete, create_by, create_time, remark) select #{tenantId}, #{merchantId}, t.role_template_id, t.role_name, t.role_key, t.role_sort, t.menu_check_strictly, t.status, 0, #{operator}, sysdate(), '由平台全局角色模板初始化' from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_role_template` t where t.status = 0 and t.is_delete = 0 and not exists ( select 1 from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_role` r where r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and r.member_id = #{merchantId} and r.is_delete = 0 and (r.role_template_id = t.role_template_id or r.role_key = t.role_key) )

insert into `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_role_menu` (tenant_id, member_id, role_id, menu_id, is_delete) select r.tenant_id, r.member_id, r.role_id, tm.menu_id, 0 from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_role` r inner join `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_role_template_menu` tm on tm.role_template_id = r.role_template_id and tm.is_delete = 0 where r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and r.member_id = #{merchantId} and r.is_delete = 0 on duplicate key update is_delete = 0
mapper.select: select role_id from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_role` where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and member_id = #{merchantId} and role_key = 'merchant_admin' and is_delete = 0 order by role_id limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_role` (tenant_id, member_id, role_name, role_key, role_sort, menu_check_strictly, status, create_by, create_time, remark, is_delete) values (#{tenantId}, #{merchantId}, '商户管理员', 'merchant_admin', 1, 1, 0, #{operator}, sysdate(), '商户审核通过后自动创建的管理员角色', 0) on duplicate key update role_id = LAST_INSERT_ID(role_id)

insert into `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_role_menu` (tenant_id, member_id, role_id, menu_id, is_delete) select #{tenantId}, #{merchantId}, #{roleId}, tm.menu_id, 0 from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_role` r inner join `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_role_template_menu` tm on tm.role_template_id = r.role_template_id and tm.is_delete = 0 where r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and r.member_id = #{merchantId} and r.role_id = #{roleId} and r.is_delete = 0 on duplicate key update is_delete = 0

insert into `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_user_role` (tenant_id, member_id, merchant_user_id, role_id, is_delete) values (#{tenantId}, #{merchantId}, #{userId}, #{roleId}, 0) on duplicate key update is_delete = 0
